text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune finds herself in Landosol's business district,
still unable to decide on the perfect present for Shiori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
繁華街でシオリへのプレゼントを探しているハツネは、
相も変わらずプレゼントを決めあぐねていた。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ahh, man! What should I do?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あうー、
どうしよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Help a sister out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くーん！
助けてよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: {0}! Perfect timing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！
　いいところに！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Remember how you told me about Shiorin's interest in monsters?
I started thinking about presents related to that, but well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前シオリンが
魔物に興味があるって教えてくれたでしょ？
あれからそれを参考にして
プレゼントを考えてたんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: There's too many options! I can't settle on just one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あげたいものが多すぎて
一つに絞れないの～！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Yeah.
I'd give her the whole bunch honestly,
but that'd probably be more of a burden than anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
そうなんだぁ……
あげられるものは何だってあげたいけど、
それだとシオリンが困るかもしれないから……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're both together again. Hello.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん、{0}さん、
こんにちは。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Waugh?! Sh-Shiorin?!
T-talk about coincidences!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁぁぁ！
　シ、シオリン！
　ぐ、偶然だねー！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I had to report in to Caon, so...
What brings you two here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
【自警団（カォン）】に近況報告してて……
お姉ちゃんと{0}さんは？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Well! We're, uh, we're just...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え！？
　えっと、
私たちは、
私たちはね～……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I might be able to figure out what she wants
if I invite her to come shopping with us!
Yup, that's the ticket!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！？
　ここでシオリンを買い物に誘えば、
欲しいものがわかるんじゃ……？
　
そうだ！
　そうだよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: You're such an ultra genius, Hatsune! ♪ Sha-shing! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネちゃん天才だね♪
　きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Is something wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん？
　どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Not at all! 
More importantly, are you free after this?
Let's go shopping together if you are!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
なんでもないよ！
　
そんなことよりシオリン！
もしこの後時間あるなら、
一緒に買い物に行こうよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Oh...
I am free, yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
うん。
大丈夫だけど……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Perfect! Then let's roll!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
それじゃあしゅっぱーつ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
There should be stores we haven't checked around here...
Oh, there's one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このへんならまだ見てないお店が……
あっ！
あそこ、雑貨屋があるよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait for us— Honestly, now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、お姉ちゃん……
もう。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Umm, {0}...
Has Hatsune asked you to help her with anything lately?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、{0}さん。
最近、
お姉ちゃんからなにか、
相談されました？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
You're as bad at fibbing as she is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
{0}さんも、
お姉ちゃんと同じくらいわかりやすいですね。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure [i]what[/i] it is,
but you're trying to do something for me, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと私のために、
なにかしようって……
そう考えてるんですよね。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's funny, really. Hatsune's always been something
of an open book to me, ever since we were kids.
We might live apart now, but that fact hasn't changed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
不思議なんですけど、
お姉ちゃんのことはなんとなくわかるんです。
小さい頃からそうでした。
別々に暮らしてても、姉妹ですから。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Knowing she's planning something for my sake makes me
really happy, you know.
But I don't want it to just end there...
choice_data_list: Hopefully you can return the favor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんが私のためになにかしてくれるの、
すごく嬉しいんです。
だから、
私もそんなお姉ちゃんに……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Yeah. One day, for sure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はい、
いつか、
かならず。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Welcome!
text_block_list.orig_text: いらっしゃーい。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
You two sure took your time!
Check it out! There's so much cool stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも遅いよー！
みてみて！
　面白そうなものがたくさんあるよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Wow, there really is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
本当だ……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
Rare, unusual books can be a staple of stores like this.
It'd be nice if I could find one of those...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね、
なにか、
こういったお店でしか出会えない
珍しい本などがあれば……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
I knew it'd be book-related!
Let's see here... Unusual books... Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりシオリンは本が欲しいんだ！
珍しい本……
どこかに……
ん？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Did something catch your eye?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん、
なにか見つけたの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
This book did, yeah.
There's magic flowing out from it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
これなんだけど……
この本から魔力が……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
A book filled with magic?
It doesn't seem like a spellbook, at the very least...
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔力の宿る本……
魔導書、
とも違いそう……

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Great catch, you two!
That book there was found in some ancient ruins not that long ago!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお！
　お姉さんたちお目が高いね！
そいつは最近とある遺跡で発掘された代物だ！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
It's a monster-based picture book, but get this! The illustrations
actually move thanks to the magic imbued in it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
中身は魔物の図鑑になってるんだけどな、
なんと魔法で
絵が生きてるかのように動くんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
絵が動くー！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Th-that's amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すごい！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
I've been in this business for a long time now,
but I ain't ever seen a book like this before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺も長年この商売をしてるが、
そんな本は初めて見たぜ。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I've read all sorts of books myself,
but this is also a first for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も、
いままでたくさん本を見てきたけど……
こんな本があったなんて……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: I take it you're curious about it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリン、
その本気になるの？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I didn't bring that much money with me today, though...
And encounters with new books can be fleeting.
There's no guarantee it'll be here next time... *sob*
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
あぅ、
でも今日はそんな持ち合わせが……
本との出会いは一期一会、
次来たときにはないかも……
うぅ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sha-shing! ☆ That's the ticket!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きらーんっ☆
　
これだー！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: H-Hatsune?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お姉ちゃん？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! Guess what, lovable sister of mine?
I've been looking for a present to give you after all your hard work, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふー！
　
実はね、
シオリンが最近頑張ってるって聞いて、
ずーっとプレゼントを探してたんだ！
　だーかーらー……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Behold! This book shall henceforth be yours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この本は、
お姉ちゃんがプレゼントしてあげよー！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: R-really?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
いいの……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: For realsies! You deserve it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの！
　シオリンへのご褒美だもん！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I like to hear! There's a bookmark that they
found along with the book, so how about grabbing that as well?
It's got a pretty neat design, I'd say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉さん太っ腹だぁ！
　
あと本に挟んであるブックマーク、
実はそいつも一緒に見つかった発掘品でな。
一緒に買っちゃうかい？
　
なかなか良いデザインしてるぜ？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Sure! Gimme the whole shebang!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　じゃあそれも一緒にちょーだい！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Great! Let's see here...
You're looking at this much for the both of them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっしゃ！
　
んじゃ本とブックマークで……
値段はこんなもんだな！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Okay... W-wait, I don't have enough?!
N-no way! So much for the perfect present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと……
わー！
　た、足りない！？
ど、どうしよう……
せっかくシオリンが欲しいもの見つけたのにー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
{0}...?
I-I can't accept this. Especially after all your help...
choice_data_list: We're both doing this for Shiori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、このお金……
わ、わるいよ。
ただでさえ相談に乗ってもらってるのに……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Okay! Thanks!
I'll pay you back real soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅぅぅ！
　
{0}くん、ありがとう！
今度返すね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Here ya go! Enough for the book and bookmark!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさん！
　これでお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Great doing business with ya!
text_block_list.orig_text: はいまいどあり！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Here you go, Shiorin!
A reward for all your hard work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
はい！
　シオリン！
いつもお仕事お疲れ様！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I really mean it.
I'll make sure to treasure this forever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん……
ありがとう。
嬉しい……
大事にするね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Woo!
Operation: Hatsune's Perfect Present is officially a success! Sha-shing! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　プレゼント作戦、
大成功～！！　
きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune, seeing Shiori's reaction to her present,
felt almost as happy as her sister did in that moment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
プレゼントを貰ってとても嬉しそうなシオリを見て、
自分まで幸せな気持ちになるハツネであった。
